candidate_contract.requested_field_binding: derive the answer role from the natural-language task and require one visible value control whose accessible metadata names that role
candidate_contract.icon_only_policy: an icon or semantic synonym is never sufficient; navigate through a visible non-commit information or edit-details path until the existing field value is readable as text
candidate_contract.read_only_policy: while a target-row inspection is active, reject typing, labeled commit controls, and taps on the requested-field selector itself
candidate_contract.capture_policy: capture a compact requested-field crop only for an explicit value immediately before an accepted press_back action
candidate_contract.evidence_integrity: retain and revalidate both the original screenshot SHA-256 and the crop SHA-256 before routing evidence
candidate_contract.aggregation_policy: route the ordered crops only after every distinct target row is visited and the current screen is again the target-date list
candidate_contract.visual_adjudication: the final critic requires exact readable wording and category granularity for every answer item and rejects icons, broad or narrow substitutes, and synonyms
candidate_contract.context_budget_policy: historical full-screen detail frames are replaced by compact requested-field crops and are withheld until final list aggregation

coverage: icon-only detail cannot be closed or answered before explicit requested-field text is visible
typing and Save-class controls are rejected during read-only inspection
the requested-field selector itself cannot be tapped during read-only inspection
the assessment exposes field role and geometry but withholds visible answer text
source and crop hashes are both checked before final evidence routing
ordered crops are routed only on the restored target-date list
the final critic rejects synonyms and category-granularity mismatches
historical r65 artifacts remain immutable after the r66 source change

native_ui_zero_model_probe.purpose: verify that the app exposes an exact existing requested-field value through a read-only navigation path before authorizing any new model request

online_boundary_at_validation.interpretation: local and native-UI validation passed, but no r66 live smoke is authorized before an exact-package zero-call preflight verifies the model route and frozen package

allowed: prepare a fresh r66 H17-only development wrapper and namespace
add exact-source freeze, prerequisite, and invocation-boundary tests
run a zero-model-call online preflight against the exact r66 package
run at most one non-scored H17 M0 smoke only after that preflight passes
forbidden: resume or overwrite the r65 development suite
launch any formal r66 Gate-F batch
run any r66 development sequence other than its single frozen H17 M0 cell
infer a requested category from an icon, synonym, or title
modify or save the inspected application record
use hidden task parameters or the offline expected answer
